topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: Well, there you have it. Master Groff brought a parcel today, and as he handed it to me, I saw it wasn’t meant for me. The name on the wrap was old, belonged to the last fellow who lived here. I took it from Master Groff’s hands, thanked him, and set it aside. Wonders what might be inside; could be seeds, letters, or maybe a keepsake. I’ll wait a turn or two and then see if I can find the right soul to give it to. No harm in that, is there? Meantime, I’ll go on tending the fields and hoping the rain holds off till the wheat is ready.
